ruleDefinitions.name: TacticalRMM Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a TacticalRMM service installation. Tactical RMM is a remote monitoring & management tool. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*tacticalrmm\\\.exe.*") OR ServiceName = RGX(".*TacticalRMM\\ Agent\\ Service.*")))
